name: Ball Ranks Fantasy Sports
tagline: Bring NFL and NBA fantasy rankings into Cline
description: Retrieve weekly football rankings, football and basketball season and player rankings, season projections for both sports, and weekly football projections. The default connection uses anonymous Model Zero access.

install.notes: Anonymous Model Zero access is limited to 10 requests per day per public IP. Create an API key at https://ballranks.com/account#developer-access for higher Model Zero limits; Model One requires Premium. See the developer documentation for Bearer authentication.
